title: Chapter 310 The Undead Monster Explodes
content:
Chapter 310 The Undead Monster Explodes

"Okay, I was right about you. Let's join forces to destroy this monster and boost morale."

After Lin Xiaodong said that, he used his feet to jump several meters and came to the air. He aimed his long sword at the belly of the undead beast and stabbed it suddenly. A huge lightning shot out along the tip of the sword.

"Bang."

A big hole was directly blown out of the belly of the undead beast, but it did not explode.

"Buzz."

The undead beast roared, and a whirlwind rolled up around it.

He suddenly collided his fists in front of his chest, and his momentum burst out.

Wang Shuo had to retreat temporarily to avoid its edge.

Afterwards, the undead beast found Lin Xiaodong's trace, and immediately collided his fists like a diamond, and swung his fist towards Lin Xiaodong's position.

Lin Xiaodong was prepared and jumped away nimbly.

This attack of the undead beast only left a huge pit several meters deep in the original place.

Wang Shuo's forehead was sweating, but he still mustered up his courage and stabbed at his anus while the undead beast was bending over.

At the same time, he launched the "Dragon Transformation Attack".

Another large piece of dry bones scattered.

It was obvious that it caused great damage to the undead beast.

At this moment, Lin Xiaodong frowned.

"Be careful..."

He shouted, stepped forward quickly, and kicked Wang Shuo's hellhound away, and Wang Shuo was kicked dozens of meters away, hitting countless houses.

Just when Wang Shuo was confused and angry.

"Bang."

The huge air wave lifted Wang Shuo again. Wang Shuo climbed up with difficulty, only to see that the undead beast just now had disappeared.

Only a huge pit was left in the original place.

The surrounding undead soldiers and human troops were cleared out in a large circle.

Wang Shuo's eyes were red, there were at least ten hellhounds there.

After a while, Wang Shuo realized.

It seems that Lin Xiaodong's figure... is also gone.

Could it be...

Wang Shuo was horrified.

Only then did he realize that Lin Xiaodong had just saved him.

Wang Shuo stood there in a daze, his mind buzzing.

If Lin Xiaodong didn't have a resurrection item, wouldn't it be...

I still have a resurrection coin!

He felt bad.

Gong Zheng also quickly got rid of his opponent, came to Wang Shuo and guarded him.

"Lord, are you okay!"

After a long pause, Wang Shuo pulled himself together and took the water of life.

He wanted to find Lin Xiaodong's voice, but found nothing.

"Ah..."

He turned around and killed crazily.

At this time, the bloodthirsty wolf was also beaten back by Xie Xiaofeng, and its health value had dropped to less than one-fifth.

He was very skilled in fighting skills, both offensive and defensive.

After fighting for a long time, he was not injured.

The next battle did not have much suspense.

With the bloodthirsty wolf's roar, his life as an undead came to an end.

Wang Shuo also vented his resentment at this time.

Seeing Xie Xiaofeng's invincible figure, he couldn't help but sigh, are humans really so powerful after reaching the level of war generals?

Have they got the strength to fight monsters of the same level alone?

After the death of the bloodthirsty demon wolf, the remaining undead became lambs to be slaughtered.

Wang Shuo led the remaining Red Flame Army and the alliance army to quickly wipe out the undead in the city.

At this time, Xie Xiaofeng came over, looked at Wang Shuo and smiled: "You are Mayor Wang, right?"

Wang Shuo was shocked. Is he so famous?

Even this kind of war general with superior combat power knows him.

"It's me."

"Hello, I am Xie Xiaofeng, the commander of the personal guards under Zhao Junshou."

"Now that the magistrate of Changping County has died, then next, you will take over Changping County and temporarily take over the position of county magistrate."
